name: darkness
lore:
### On the Manifestation of True Night

To evoke the spell *Darkness* is to weave a shroud from the very threads of the Void. Unlike the mere absence of light, this magic manifests as a gelatinous, ink-black sphere that actively devours luminescence. It is a physical presence—a heavy, suffocating weight that clings to the skin like wet silk. When shaping the Weave, the arcanist feels a bone-deep chill, as if their fingers are dipping into an ancient, oily well that resists the touch of life.

Scholars trace the spell’s genesis to the **Blind Weaver of Ul-Dara**. Legend claims she grew weary of the world’s vibrant distractions and the searing gaze of the sun. Reaching into the hollow of her own sightless eyes, she pulled the internal void outward, anchoring it to a physical mote. In doing so, she taught us that shadows are not merely cast, but *commanded*.

*Caution to the novice:* Within this gloom, sound muffles and direction falters. You do not merely step into the dark; you step out of the world.
